_howToEdit: To add a review, copy one { ... } block, paste it after the last one, and change the text. Put a comma between blocks, but not after the last one. rating is a number from 1 to 5. Save the file and reload the website; no rebuild is needed. If the reviews disappear, a comma or quote is out of place: paste the file into jsonlint.com to find it.
